# Expected results (documentation only, no raw CSV)

## Synthetic demo

The fixed 6-object / 12-request demo in `core/examples/synthetic_demo.py` prints:

```text
strategy     transfer_B  pubs  hits verified
none                816     6     0     True
comm_only           560     6     6     True
joint               560     6     6     True
full_retain         560     6     6     True
PASS
```

## Paper results (not regenerated by CI)

- Graph task: receiver reuse lowers object payload from 165,888 B to 83,232 B
  (49.83%) under a 288 B persistent budget; predictions match the same-device full-graph
  reference element-wise.
- Controlled fresh service: a 50% budget lowers new publications from 180 to 52.
- The joint score often reduces to communication-only or frequency-based scoring; see the
  paper's tables 4-7.
- At 50% fresh, candidate coverage accounts for about 81% of the gap to the post-hoc
  upper bound; this is a diagnostic, not a deployable policy.

The paper's exact run tables are not shipped as raw CSVs. See `docs/paper_mapping.md`.
